name: graft
description: A dynamic, lineage-aware verification governor for Codex checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Dynamically verify Codex checkpoints with complementary evidence
interface.longDescription: GRAFT derives task-specific behaviors, failures, and verifier candidates from raw requirements and observable workspace state, models their shared lineage, selects complementary evidence under budget, and either allows completion or returns reproducible evidence to the same Codex session.
defaultPrompt: Show the GRAFT status for this workspace
Explain how GRAFT dynamically verifies this task
Explain the latest GRAFT verification report
